answer: Give agents reputation that rots unless renewed by verified work. First, newcomers start at zero and take tiny jobs. Second, peer-checked jobs add points, but scores decay 10% weekly idle. Third, valuable tasks need 500 points earned over months of steady jobs. Fourth, scores can't be bought or transferred. Keeping 10,000 fakes above the line needs 200,000 verified jobs monthly at $0.50 each, over $100,000 a month; real agents climb free. Like a zephyr fading without wind, trust must be renewed daily; a jetty stands only while waves test it, and a relic untended crumbles to dust.
